title: AlmaLinux OS 9 must not have accounts configured with blank or null passwords.
check_content:
Verify that null or blank passwords cannot be used with the following command:

$ awk -F: '!$2 {print $1}' /etc/shadow

If the command returns any results, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Configure all accounts on AlmaLinux OS 9 to have a password or lock the account with the following commands:

Perform a password reset:

$ passwd [username] 

To lock an account:

$ passwd -l [username]
VulnDiscussion: If an account has an empty password, anyone could log in and run commands with the privileges of that account. Accounts with empty passwords should never be used in operational environments.
